page_title: RBL 0-0 BOC | RB Leipzig v Bochum 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' A cross by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
90+3' RB Leipzig force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
88' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by David Raum (RB Leipzig) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
88' Thomas Letsch prepares a substitution. Patrick Osterhage is replaced by Erhan Masovic (Bochum).
87' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
86' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
84' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
82' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Takuma Asano.
81' The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
78' A substitution has been made. Xavi Simons goes off and Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) comes on.
78' Today's match ends for Xaver Schlager who will be replaced by Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig).
78' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Lois Openda will be replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).

77' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Manuel Riemann dived superbly to block a header by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the right post, but Manuel Riemann pulled off a remarkable save!
75' RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Here is a change. Goncalo Paciencia is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
72' Substitution. Cristian Gamboa leaves the pitch and is replaced by Noah Loosli (Bochum).
70' A snap shot by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Manuel Riemann flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
69' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is given a yellow card.
66' 5:0 – the corner kicks stats.
64' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
63' The attendance for today's match is 44269.
63' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
62' The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.
61' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but Manuel Riemann pulls off a superb save.
60' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
58' A clumsy foul by Ivan Ordets (Bochum) and Timo Gerach blows his whistle. RB Leipzig are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
57' Substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Benjamin Sesko walks off.
57' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) replaces Christoph Baumgartner.
55' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Ivan Ordets (Bochum) for his blatant foul.
55' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
52' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
49' The RB Leipzig players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Timo Gerach didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Manuel Riemann was alert and made an astonishing save!
42' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
39' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for RB Leipzig.
37' The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Takuma Asano (Bochum) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
34' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
32' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' Takuma Asano (Bochum) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
28' Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul after Anthony Losilla (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents.

27' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Manuel Riemann anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
27' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

26' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) brings an opponent down and Timo Gerach interrupts the game. The referee gives a penalty to RB Leipzig after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
25' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Riemann comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' David Raum (RB Leipzig) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
23' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
21' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
20' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) climbs high to meet a cross on the edge of the box, but it's a poor header and goes well wide of the left post.
19' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
15' One of the RB Leipzig players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
15' RB Leipzig control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
11' The free kick is delivered by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
10' Referee Timo Gerach sees the trip by Bernardo (Bochum) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
7' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig).
5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
4' Timo Gerach blows the whistle, Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is penalised for a foul.
3' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

1' That didn't go as planned! Takuma Asano (Bochum) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Janis Blaswich, who easily kept it out.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
